business_problem: Second Harvest Heartland was supporting growing volumes of neighbors through voicemail and email triage, personal cellphones, and slow manual intake, so responses could take up to two months and staff had limited ability to guide people through benefit programs efficiently.
solution_summary: Second Harvest Heartland replaced a manual voicemail-and-email intake model with a ServiceNow support stack centered on Public Sector Digital Services, Customer Service Management, and 3CLogic. Residents now contact a single call-center number or email, and agents work inside ServiceNow instead of reviewing messages on personal cellphones. Public Sector Digital Services provides the workflow and case-management foundation, while Customer Service Management stores neighbor history, documentation, and guided support steps for long benefits-assistance conversations. 3CLogic adds computer telephony integration and screen pops so callers can be matched with the right context immediately. Agents use the platform to capture up to 250 SNAP application data points conversationally, auto-populate the government PDF, email it to the neighbor, and keep the record in ServiceNow for follow-up, dashboards, reporting, and compliance-oriented visibility.

solution_components.name: Public Sector Digital Services
solution_components.role: Provides the workflow and case-management foundation for neighbor-support processes.

solution_components.name: Customer Service Management
solution_components.role: Stores case history, guidance, and service records so agents can support neighbors from one system.

solution_components.name: 3CLogic
solution_components.role: Supplies telephony integration, automated screen pops, call metrics, and call recording for the contact center.

data_flow: Telephone and email inquiries enter a centralized team through 3CLogic, which opens the ServiceNow record and related history for the agent. Agents use Public Sector Digital Services and Customer Service Management to capture benefit-application details, generate the completed PDF, email it to the neighbor, and retain the case for dashboards, reporting, and later follow-up.
business_outcome: Second Harvest Heartland supported almost 2,000 calls in the first month, more than 8,000 neighbors by the end of month three, returned calls 74% faster, and nearly doubled Q1 2024 Senior Food Box enrollments compared with the same period in 2023 while giving agents better context for more personal support.
metrics: 8,000 Neighbors supported in first three months
Senior Food Box (CSFP) program enrollments in Q1 2024 were nearly double the same period in 2023

Agents capture all 250 SNAP application data points conversationally and auto-populate the government PDF.
Supervisors manage dashboards, call counts, call duration, and call recording from within ServiceNow.
